It reads the shared derived walk (_output_lints.prose_scan_set over .md .py .sh .js .mjs .yml .yaml .toml). It reads a document's own markup for the steps it holds (_md_steps: numbered headings including a two-number heading, top-level items, a lettered top-level item on its own, nested letters including a lettered range, <heading>.<item> under an integer heading, fences skipped).
